cardEffects:
[Security] [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, if all of your Digimon and Tamers have the [D-Reaper] trait, for each of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]'s digivolution cards, the attacking Digimon get -1000 DP for the turn.
[Main] If you have no face-up security cards, by trashing your top security card, place this card face up as your top security card.
name: D-Reaper Zone

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT19-100 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)
Official JP Q&A for BT19-100 (2024/11/22, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No, you cannot. All of your Digimon and tamers in the Battle Area must have "De Reaper" as a trait to activate it.
rulings.question: Can this card's [Security] effect be activated even if there is a Digimon with "De-Reaper" in its trait and a Tamer without "De-Reaper" in its trait in the Battle Area?

rulings.answer: Yes, it can be activated. Text that does not describe which location can specify or refer to a Battle Area and affect the Battle Area. In the case of this card's [Security] effect, it can be activated if all of your Digimon and Tamer in the Battle Area have "De Reaper" as a trait.
rulings.question: Can this card's [Security] effect be activated even if all my Digimon and Tamer in Battle Area have "De-Reaper" in their traits and my Digimon in Breeding Area do not have "De-Reaper" in their traits?

rulings.answer: No, it cannot be activated. Text that does not describe which location can specify or reference a Battle Area and affects the Battle Area. In the case of this card's [Security] effect, it cannot be activated if there is no one of your Digimon or Tamer with "De-Reaper" in its trait in the Battle Area.
rulings.question: Can this card's [Security] effect be activated even if my Digimon and Tamer are not in the Battle Area and my Digimon with the trait "De-Reaper" is in the Breeding Area?

rulings.answer: Yes, it can be used. However, it cannot activate this effect because it does not meet the condition of the [Main] effect of this card, "if you have no face-up security of your own".
rulings.question: Can I use this card in my hand when I have my own face-up security?

rulings.answer: It becomes ostensible security and remains public. The rules are the same as for normal security, except that it is ostensible.
rulings.question: What happens to a card placed face up in security by an effect?

rulings.answer: No, it cannot. It must be activated when the opponent's Digimon attacks.
rulings.question: Can I choose not to activate the [Security] effect of this card when my opponent's Digimon attacks?

rulings.answer: Checked as published. The rules are the same as for normal checks, except as published.
rulings.question: What happens when checking a security placed face down?
If a security placed face up is checked, does the card's [Security] effect trigger?

rulings.answer: The security that was face up is turned back face down and then shuffled. After shuffling, the cards are not turned face up.
rulings.question: What happens when shuffling a security that contains a security placed face up?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 [D-Reaper] trait card with a play cost equal to or lower than the number of digivolution cards of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]'s from your hand without paying the cost.
